host: Ubuntu 24.04, gcc 13.3.0 -O2, instrumented copy of Unshackled.c (repo binary unchanged)
claim: The Linux-built Unshackled VM runs at ~3.2-3.7M steps/s; the HeLL backend carries a fixed ~10-15M-step and ~2.6 MB overhead per program regardless of program size.
consequence_for_M3: One Doom tick needs on the order of 1e10-1e12 steps (Doom tick ~35 Hz in C; thinkers, RNG, movement, WAD access all inside the VM). At 3.5M steps/s that is hours per tick, and the HeLL memory pre-initialization adds ~2.6 MB per program before any logic runs. M3 as literally specified (H(S_t+1)==H(S_t)_C for a real Doom tick) is NOT_DEMONSTRATED and its cost is not yet bounded; a scoped minimal-tick claim is the honest next target.
